claims: 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal game between the United States and the Dominican Republic occurred on March 15
United States defeated the Dominican Republic 2-1 in the 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal
Game was at LoanDepot Park in Miami
Victory secured United States' third consecutive appearance in the World Baseball Classic championship game
Paul Skenes of USA allowed one run over 4 1/3 innings for the win
Junior Caminero of Dominican Republic hit a solo home run in the second inning
Gunnar Henderson hit a solo home run in the top of the fourth inning
Roman Anthony hit a solo home run in the top of the fourth inning
Gunnar Henderson and Roman Anthony hit back-to-back solo home runs
Those home runs gave the U.S. the lead
U.S. advances to the 2026 WBC final
U.S. to face winner of Japan vs. Venezuela in the 2026 WBC final
